DT_BuildObjectDescText.BUILDOBJECT_DESC_PAE_ExchangePrototype: Exchange Awakening Crystals between nine elements at a 1:1 ratio. Produces one crystal per second while powered. Idle power: 36,000/s; total operating power: 576,000/s. Pauses without power and resumes when power returns.
